title: Costa del Este Watersports
specs: Exclusive location on the Intracoastal Waterway with direct access to ocean and Lake Boca
Party boat includes Bluetooth sound system, full bar, swim ladder, USB ports, and shaded areas
Guests can bring own food, drinks, and play their own music
Must be at least 18 years old, have a Boating Safety Card, and valid photo ID to operate a waverunner or boat alone
Must take 20-minute FWC Boating Test unless born before Jan 1, 1988
Minors cannot operate waverunners or boats; must be accompanied by adult
Party boat maximum 18 people; luxury charters up to 40 on catamaran or yacht

options.name: Luxury Yacht Charters
options.detail: Luxury charters available on various yachts from 27' up to 68', with captain and crew, some with staterooms and overnight options.

options.name: Waverunner (Jetski) Rentals
options.detail: Jetski rentals from the Waterstone Resort & Marina dock for direct access to ocean and Lake Boca.

options.name: Center Console Boat Rentals
options.detail: Boat rentals for outings on the Intracoastal Waterway only, departing from Waterstone Resort & Marina.

options.name: Pontoon Boat Rentals
options.detail: Pontoon boats for rental on the Intracoastal Waterway, launching from Waterstone Resort & Marina.

options.name: Pedal Kayak Rentals
options.detail: Pedal-powered kayak rentals for fitness and sightseeing.

options.name: Boating Lessons
options.detail: Immersive boating lessons covering safety, navigation, docking, and local waterway rules.

blurb: Costa del Este Watersports offers waverunner (jetski), center console boat, pontoon boat, pedal kayak rentals, private party boat trips, boating lessons, and luxury yacht charters. Activities depart from the Waterstone Resort & Marina with direct access to the Intracoastal Waterway and Lake Boca. Options for captain services and private group outings are available.
extraNote: Reservation deposits are fully refundable with at least 24 hours’ notice · Reservations may be rescheduled due to severe weather (heavy rain, lightning or thunder) or cancelled for refund · Full payment required at end of trip; deposit due at booking · No smoking or drug use on party boat; vaping permitted · No pets allowed on boats · Glass containers not allowed (wine/champagne bottles excepted), no red wine · Waterstone Resort & Marina dock; also possible pickup at The Boca Raton Resort (members/guests only)
